problem.title: Minimum Cost to Reach Last Cell
problem.problemStatement: Given an R × C grid where each cell contains a traversal cost, determine the minimum cost required to reach the bottom-right corner from the top-left corner by moving only right or down.
problem.input: • First line contains integers R and C. • Next R lines each contain C integers.
